cited.quote: Sewage disposal systems including underground sewerage systems will be provided to fully cover the urban population

rationale: C2 is a budget speech statement of intent on urban sewage and solid waste generally, not an administrative order on sewage discharge into Chennai rivers. C1, C3, C4, C5 are unrelated GOs (bus disposal, department renaming, land alienation, ministers' business). No official step shown.

cited.quote: The scheme to prevent outflow of sewage into waterways in Chennai will be vigorously implemented

rationale: C1 is a budget speech intent on preventing sewage outflow into Chennai waterways; it says nothing of anti-mosquito or malodour measures and is not an operational step. C2 is a governor's address on Singara Chennai plans; C3-C5 concern agriculture. No launch of mosquito/malodour measures shown.

No extract concerns a bus stand at Siruseri. C1 and C2 are a CAG audit of a Gandarvakottai bus stand, C3 mentions modernising bus stands generally, C4 lists bus stands as KNMT eligible works, and C5 is a hospital list.

No extract mentions an industrial estate in Chidambaram or gold covering/imitation jewellery. C1, C2 are general industries policy note text, C3 an MSME policy GO distribution list, C4 KNMT guidelines, C5 general MSME budget announcements.

cited.quote: For creation of infrastructure for health care of animals and establishment of fodder banks

rationale: C1 is an agriculture budget allocation for animal health infrastructure, not health cards for pets or livestock, and is only a budget announcement. C2, C4 concern employee health insurance identity cards; C3, C5 are Covid relief/lockdown GOs. No step to issue animal health cards.

cited.quote: it is imperative to strengthen the processing infrastructure and to provide animal health care at doorsteps of farmers

rationale: C1 is a budget statement allocating funds to strengthen dairy processing infrastructure; no GO or launch of Aavin technology upgrade or interstate marketing. C2 reports an Aavin milk price cut, a different measure. C3-C5 unrelated.

cited.quote: An amount of Rs.1.50 crore has been allocated for the transgender pension scheme, benefiting 1,071 destitute transgender persons

rationale: C1 reports a budget allocation for the transgender pension scheme but no raise of assistance from Rs 1000 to Rs 1500. C4 mentions skill training for transgenders only. C2, C3, C5 unrelated. No official step for the increase.

No extract concerns a pension scheme for transport employees. C2-C5 fix interest rates under the Contributory Pension Scheme for government employees generally, and C1 is a group insurance GO for local body and aided-institution staff.

TAMIN is carrying out mining operations in a systematic and scientific manner by adopting modern techniques

rationale: C2 states TAMIN's mission and C1 describes ongoing operations and planned initiatives in a policy note; neither shows a new official step (GO, sanction, scheme) to strengthen TAMIN's technological capacity. C3-C5 unrelated.

No extract concerns interest-free loans to BPL women for cottage industries. C1, C2 describe TIIC loan schemes for industrial units, C3 crop/jewel loan waivers, C4 NRLM fund release, C5 NEEDS entrepreneur subsidy changes.

rationale: C4 is a budget speech announcement that employment centres will be reinvigorated and coaching classes introduced; it is a statement of intent, not a GO or launch. C1, C2 are urban wage employment guidelines, C3, C5 unrelated.

No extract concerns appointing road workers to TNRDC. C1, C3 are urban employment scheme guidelines, C2 rural roads budget text, C4 a bypass land acquisition sanction, C5 governor's address on roads and transport.

rationale: C1, the governor's address, states the Government will urge the Union on citizenship for Sri Lankan Tamil refugees; this is a statement of intent, not a formal step such as an Assembly resolution or CM's letter. C2-C5 unrelated.

cited.quote: The students studying in Classes 1 to 10 are being provided with nutritious noon meal

rationale: C1 describes the existing noon meal programme for school students, a related nutrition scheme, but no extract shows morning milk being provided. C2 lists other student welfare schemes; C3-C5 concern Aavin price, NEET and admission reservations. No step for morning milk.
